interpretationLimits: NCERT national baseline only, not all Indian boards.
Formal Preparatory stage covers Grades 3–5 / ages 8–11 once, with attainment across/by the end of that stage; no universal age-eight deadline.
Local examples and school resources require an accurate declared locality/date/access binding; another community’s calendar or government arrangement is not silently universalised.
Broad goals explicitly compose all relevant child protocols and include an independent transfer; tags/counts alone do not certify a goal.
Mixed orientations retain actual knowledge/actions alongside contextual ethical concern; no forced mood, belief, affection or morality score.
No new topic/claim/guide/dependency change. All old whole-card demands, source flags and scoped contexts retained.
All 570 accepted positions receive a review disposition when this slice is integrated; conditional language/art-form bindings and the unresolved physical musical-scale phrase are not silently Full.
Out-of-catalogue Hindi/Urdu advisory material and other-board source discovery remain separately unverified inventory, not fabricated accepted records.
Narrow inherited diagnostic/rubric success does not certify every field or item in a broader whole card; actual source duties and complete whole-card checks are distinguished.

existingGuideInterpretationCautions.meaning: The Moon goes around Earth while both also travel around the Sun. Distinguish reference frames; an accurate combined-motion account must not be marked wrong by an inherited shorthand rubric.
Interpreting a supplied map/model is distinct from constructing an own land-and-water model. Complete construction checks separately; do not infer them from map reading.
The whole resource claim requires actually obtaining and combining information. Sorting labels, naming impacts or reading one supplied simulation alone does not establish that practice.

Systematic records can come from observation, including weather or organisms, without a controlled experiment. The inherited hard path is not authority to declare a one-variable experiment universally necessary for recording; unchanged whole-card/path checks remain separate.

During isothermal melting, energy can change the state without requiring a particle-speed or temperature increase. Do not punish an accurate plateau explanation because inherited particle/heating shorthand conflicts. Microscopic diagrams remain a separately checked model, not a universal national prerequisite for observable state grouping.

Declare the observer/landmark reference frame for positional terms. Advanced dual relations or another person’s viewpoint are not universal gates for basic position competence; a narrow inherited diagnostic is not whole-inventory proof.
